description: AsterDrive instance-scoped metrics: HTTP/DB/auth/tasks, measured file stream throughput and lifecycle, upload phases/backlog, capacity/staging validity, blob cleanup, remote transport, process/runtime health, and OTLP export diagnostics. Prometheus-compatible data source required. Select one deployment for database-wide snapshots; independent target-capacity minima and both ends of remote I/O must not be summed. Presigned transfers bypassing AD have no measured stream bytes. Traces/Tempo are separate.

panels.description: Minimum scrape health across the selected Prometheus targets: DOWN if any selected target is down. The environment, role, and runtime instance filters apply to application metrics only; scrape health follows Job and Target.

targets.expr: min(up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Target Health

panels.description: Youngest process uptime among the selected runtime instances; a drop highlights restarts.

targets.expr: min(process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"})

panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Total RSS memory of the selected runtime instances.

targets.expr: sum(process_memory_usage_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"})

panels.title: RSS Memory

panels.description: Total CPU cores consumed across selected runtime instances. 1.0 means one full CPU core.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(rate(process_cpu_time_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]), 0))

panels.title: CPU Cores

panels.description: Total HTTP request throughput across selected targets.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: HTTP RPS

panels.description: Ratio of HTTP 5xx responses over all HTTP responses.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Ratio

panels.description: Request rate by method, route pattern, and status. High-cardinality raw paths are intentionally not used by AsterDrive.

targets.expr: sum by (http_request_method, http_route, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request Rate By Route

panels.description: HTTP request latency across all routes.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: HTTP Latency

panels.description: Response rate grouped by HTTP status code.

targets.expr: sum by (http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: HTTP Status Mix

panels.description: Slowest route patterns by p95 latency.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Slow Routes P95

panels.description: Client and server error ratios. 401/403/404 are included in the 4xx series.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: HTTP Error Ratios

panels.description: SeaORM query throughput grouped by backend, SQL kind, and status.

targets.expr: sum by (db_system_name, db_operation_name, error_type) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: DB Queries

panels.description: SeaORM query latency p95 grouped by backend and SQL kind.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, db_system_name, db_operation_name) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: DB Query Latency P95

panels.description: Database query error rate. Any sustained non-zero value deserves log inspection.

targets.expr: sum by (db_system_name, db_operation_name) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: DB Errors

panels.description: Total DB query throughput across all SQL kinds.

targets.expr: sum by (db_system_name) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: DB QPS

panels.description: Total DB average latency from histogram sum/count. Use this alongside p95, not instead of it.

targets.expr: sum by (db_system_name, db_operation_name) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (db_system_name, db_operation_name) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: DB Average Latency

panels.description: Storage driver operations grouped by driver, operation, status, and kind.

targets.expr: sum by (driver, operation, status, kind) (rate(aster_drive_storage_driver_operations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Storage Operations

panels.description: Storage driver operation p95 latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, driver, operation, status) (rate(aster_drive_storage_driver_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Storage Latency P95

panels.description: Storage not_found rate. For thumbnail/cache probes this can be expected; for blob reads it needs investigation.

targets.expr: sum by (driver, operation) (rate(aster_drive_storage_driver_operations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", status="failure", kind="not_found"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Storage Not Found

panels.description: Storage failures excluding not_found. This is the better alert input than all failures.

targets.expr: sum by (driver, operation, kind) (rate(aster_drive_storage_driver_operations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", status="failure", kind!="not_found"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Storage Hard Failures

panels.description: Average storage operation latency from histogram sum/count.

targets.expr: sum by (driver, operation, status) (rate(aster_drive_storage_driver_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (driver, operation, status) (rate(aster_drive_storage_driver_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Storage Average Latency

panels.description: File upload results by mode and status.

targets.expr: sum by (mode, status) (rate(aster_drive_file_uploads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Uploads

panels.description: Upload sessions created by mode.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(aster_drive_upload_sessions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Upload Sessions

panels.description: Download outcomes by source and range mode.

targets.expr: sum by (source, outcome, range) (rate(aster_drive_file_downloads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Downloads

panels.description: Upload session lifecycle events such as complete and cancel.

targets.expr: sum by (mode, event, status) (rate(aster_drive_upload_session_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Upload Session Events

panels.description: Upload and download failures. A small number can be normal during client aborts; sustained growth is not.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(aster_drive_file_uploads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", status!="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (source) (rate(aster_drive_file_downloads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", outcome="failure"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Upload / Download Attempt Failures

panels.description: Bytes consumed by AD streams, including bytes before failure or cancellation. Presigned transfers and external redirects bypassing AD contribute no measured bytes. Internal remote I/O is shown separately; do not add remote to user-facing sources.

targets.expr: sum by (direction, source, mode) (rate(aster_drive_file_transfer_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Actual AD Throughput

panels.description: Each stream stays active until EOF, error, or drop; returning response headers does not finish it.

targets.expr: sum by (direction, source, mode) (aster_drive_file_transfers_in_flight{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"})

panels.title: Streams In Flight

panels.description: Full observed stream duration, including failed and cancelled streams. Quantiles merge histogram buckets before calculation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, direction, source, mode, outcome) (rate(aster_drive_file_transfer_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Stream Lifecycle P95

panels.description: Ratios use completed stream lifecycle histogram counts. Cancelled means the body/future was dropped before a terminal result. No traffic remains no data.

targets.expr: sum by (direction, source) (rate(aster_drive_file_transfer_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", outcome="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (direction, source) (rate(aster_drive_file_transfer_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (direction, source) (rate(aster_drive_file_transfer_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", outcome="cancelled"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (direction, source) (rate(aster_drive_file_transfer_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failed / Cancelled Stream Ratio

panels.description: Assemble, finalize, complete, and ingest timings represent their own boundaries; nested phases must not be added together.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, mode, phase, status) (rate(aster_drive_upload_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Upload Phase P95

panels.description: Database-wide snapshot, deduplicated with max across replicas reading the same database. Shows successful samples younger than 180 seconds; failed or stale samples are absent. Select one deployment when comparing its backlog.

targets.expr: max by (mode, state) ((aster_drive_upload_sessions_active{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"} and on(job, instance, service_instance_id) (aster_drive_observability_snapshot_valid{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} == 1 and on(job, instance, service_instance_id, source) (time() - aster_drive_observability_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} < 180))))

panels.title: Persisted Upload Sessions

panels.description: Maximum age since session creation, by mode/state. Expired sessions are shown separately. Failed/stale samples are absent.

targets.expr: max by (mode, state) ((aster_drive_upload_session_oldest_age_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"} and on(job, instance, service_instance_id) (aster_drive_observability_snapshot_valid{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} == 1 and on(job, instance, service_instance_id, source) (time() - aster_drive_observability_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} < 180))))

panels.title: Oldest Upload Session

panels.description: Stable resource boundaries: quota, target capacity, staging capacity, concurrency, and capacity unavailable. These are admission events, not stream failures.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(aster_drive_upload_admission_rejections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Upload Admission Rejections

panels.description: Capacity values are visible only when their supported/current marker is 1. Filesystem space shared by staging and other users of the same mount; per-instance observations must not be summed.

targets.expr: (aster_drive_storage_capacity_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", scope="staging_filesystem"} and (aster_drive_storage_capacity_known{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", scope="staging_filesystem"} == 1)) and on(job, instance, service_instance_id) (aster_drive_observability_snapshot_valid{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="staging_filesystem"} == 1 and on(job, instance, service_instance_id, source) (time() - aster_drive_observability_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="staging_filesystem"} < 180))

panels.title: Staging Filesystem

panels.description: Capacity values are visible only when their supported/current marker is 1. Available, total, and used are independent minima of observed targets. They can come from different targets: never sum these series or derive a used/total ratio. Unknown dimensions remain absent.

targets.expr: aster_drive_storage_capacity_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", scope="observed_target_minimum"} and (aster_drive_storage_capacity_known{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", scope="observed_target_minimum"} == 1)

panels.title: Observed Target Capacity Minima

panels.description: Declared reservations and staged reservations are database-wide logical budgets (max across replicas), not measured on-disk bytes. Staged reservations are a subset of declared reservations. Safety floor is configured per process; do not add these series.

targets.expr: max by (kind) ((aster_drive_upload_staging_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", kind!="safety_floor"} and on(job, instance, service_instance_id) (aster_drive_observability_snapshot_valid{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} == 1 and on(job, instance, service_instance_id, source) (time() - aster_drive_observability_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} < 180))))

aster_drive_upload_staging_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", kind="safety_floor"}

panels.title: Staging Reservations & Safety Floor

panels.description: 1 means the dimension is supported and current; 0 means unknown/unavailable. The corresponding capacity value is hidden when 0, even if an earlier sample existed.

targets.expr: aster_drive_storage_capacity_known{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}

panels.title: Capacity Dimension Known

panels.description: Database-wide pending blob count and oldest cleanup age. Retries retain the original cleanup interval. Uses max across replicas and excludes invalid/stale database samples.

targets.expr: max((aster_drive_blob_cleanup_pending{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"} and on(job, instance, service_instance_id) (aster_drive_observability_snapshot_valid{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} == 1 and on(job, instance, service_instance_id, source) (time() - aster_drive_observability_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance", source="database"} < 180))))

panels.title: Cleanup Backlog

panels.description: Primary database projection of last probe state, not a live network probe during scrape. max deduplicates primary replicas sharing a database; invalid/stale snapshots are absent.

sum(rate(aster_telemetry_export_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", service_name="asterdrive", aster_metrics_schema_version="aster-metrics/v1", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", aster_role=~"$role", service_instance_id=~"$runtime_instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
